Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep — but only once the run (together with any sibling runs for the same dst/src pair) covers every byte of the struct. Collapsing a run that leaves a gap WIDENS the copy and changes behaviour; see `partial_struct_copy` (§31) for that case.

*(...)(pcVar10 + 0x740): the pointer is based on a field at offset 0x0 (size 32 in CGlass) but the +0x740 byte offset lands in field texture_u (offset 0x740). Ghidra anchored on the wrong field — rewrite as direct access to texture_u (#15 base-shift; forms an out-of-array pointer, trips UBSan).

*(...)(pcVar10 + 0x7a4): the pointer is based on a field at offset 0x0 (size 32 in CGlass) but the +0x7a4 byte offset lands in field texture_v (offset 0x7a4). Ghidra anchored on the wrong field — rewrite as direct access to texture_v (#15 base-shift; forms an out-of-array pointer, trips UBSan).
